# @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt
**English** | 中文
> Edit the user-global instructions file (`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`) from the DeepSeek Harness Web settings
UI — no need to open the `.dsh` folder by hand.
> Based on couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt (MIT, © couplingartist); this repository fixes its packa
ging so the plugin actually installs, and continues the work.
## What you get
| Situation | Behavior |
| Settings → **全局指令** (Global instructions) | A new settings section: multiline editor + Save button

+ file path + character count |
| First save | Creates `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` if it does not exist (UTF

-8, no BOM) |
| Single source of truth | The settings page reads/writes the same file external edito

rs do — no second copy |
| Effect timing | Follows the harness's touch-driven reload: new sessions r
ead the latest content immediately; open sessions re-read on their next successful file tool call or

turn |
| Security | The HTTP API answers loopback (127.0.0.1) only; request bodies capped at 1 MiB

turn |
| Security | The HTTP API answers loopback (127.0.0.1) only; request bodies capped at 1 MiB |
## What this fork fixes
As published, upstream could never be installed from GitHub or npm:
| Defect (upstream) | Fix (here) |
| `lib/` gitignored, no `prepare`/`prepack` → `dsh plugin add github:...` installs an empty shell (`
ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`) | Prebuilt `lib/` is committed, and `prepack` rebuilds before `npm publish` |
| The npm name `dsh-global-prompt` belongs to an unrelated project | Published as `@zfgcta/dsh-glob

al-prompt` |
| Peers pinned to `0.1.1-rc.2` → dsh 0.2.x rejects the install | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-clie

nt-*` ranges `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` + `engines.dsh` |
| `dsh.client.inject` lists modules that no l
onger exist in the shell | Now lists `dsh-client-ui-slots` / `dsh-client-ui-primitives` (verified ag

ainst the 0.2.0-rc.2 frozen module table) |
| Client bundle id hardcoded to the old name; source map

leaks local paths | Registers under the full package id; source maps disabled |
| No LICENSE / CHAN
GELOG / engines | Added (MIT) |

# 中文
**English** | 中文
> 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 设置界面里直接编辑**用户全局指令文件**（`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`），不必再手动打开 `.dsh` 目录改文件。
> 基于 couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt（MIT，© couplingartist）；本仓库修复了它的打包问题使其真正可安装，并继续维护。
## 你会得到什么
| 场景 | 行为 |

| 设置 → **全局指令** | 新增一个设置分区页：多行编辑器 + 保存按钮 + 文件路径显示 + 字符数统计 |
| 首次保存 | 文件不存在时自动创建 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`（U

TF-8 无 BOM） |
| 唯一真源 | 设置页与外部编辑器读写同一份文件，没有第二份数据 |
| 生效时机 | 遵循系统触摸驱动刷新：新会话立即读到最新内容；已打开会话在下一次成功文件工具调用或

新一轮时重新读取 |
| 安全 | HTTP 接口仅允许本机回环（127.0.0.1）访问；请求体上限 1 MiB |
## 本仓库修复了什么
上游原版按它发布的样子在 GitHub / npm 上根本装不上：
| 缺陷（上游） | 修复（本仓库） |
| `lib/` 被 gitignore 且没有 `prepare`/`prepack` → `dsh plugin add github:...` 装出来是空壳（`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FO

UND`） | 预构建的 `lib/` 直接入库，并在 `npm publish` 前用 `prepack` 重新构建 |
| npm 上的 `dsh-global-prompt` 包名属于另一个无关

项目 | 改名发布为 `@zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt` |
| peer 钉死 `0.1.1-rc.2` → 被 dsh 0.2.x 拒装 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh

-client-*` 改为范围 `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`，并声明 `engines.dsh` |
| `dsh.client.inject` 引用了外壳里已不存在的模块 | 改为

0.2.0-rc.2 冻结模块表实际存在的 `dsh-client-ui-slots` / `dsh-client-ui-primitives` |
| 客户端 bundle id 硬编码旧名；so

urcemap 泄漏本地路径 | 按完整包名注册；关闭 sourcemap |
| 缺 LICENSE / CHANGELOG / engines | 已补齐（MIT） |
